description.part1: Created in 2015 by a group of friends passionate about video games, our esports club grew and became THG association, with the ambition to be a reference club in Rennes and Brittany!
description.part2: We mainly compete in League of Legends and Teamfight Tactics. After a few years as amateurs, we're taking a step forward this year by launching ourselves for the first time in official Riot Games competition!

image.alt: Team High Ground - Breton esports association

team.title: THG founders
team.description: Meet the people who carry the THG project and support our players in this new competitive adventure.

alex.name: Alexandre Martin
alex.description: Passionate about video games since always, Alexandre gathered friends in 2015 to create THG. Former occasional player, he now coordinates the association's development and supports the team in this first year of official competition.

sarah.name: Sarah Dubois
sarah.description: League of Legends player for several years, Sarah takes care of coordinating our LoL team. She helps us improve and prepares us for our first official tournaments by analyzing our games.

kevin.name: Kevin Le Gall
kevin.description: Kevin manages our social media and communication. He helps make THG known and documents our journey in this first year of competition. He also occasionally streams our games.

emma.name: Emma Rousseau
emma.description: Our best TFT player, Emma helps us progress on Teamfight Tactics. She shares her knowledge of the game and represents us in the few TFT tournaments we participate in.

lucas.name: Lucas Moreau
lucas.description: Lucas takes care of technical aspects: our website, streaming configurations and IT support for the team. He helps us when we have technical problems during games.

marie.name: Marie Lefevre
marie.description: Marie helps us develop our relationships with other associations and look for potential local partners. She also takes care of administrative procedures to participate in official competitions.
